# brilliant-msg examples (Python)

<!-- Generated by tools/generate_example_indexes.py — edit the example docstrings/READMEs, not this file. -->

Host-side examples for the `brilliant-msg` message layer on Brilliant Labs glasses (Halo and Frame).

Most examples are two files: the host-side Python program here and a device-side Lua app (in `lua/`) that it uploads with `upload_frame_app()` after uploading the standard Lua libraries. The two sides pass messages identified by a single-byte message code, so the codes in the Python and Lua files must match exactly.

## Examples

| Example | Device-side Lua | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [`audio_clip.py`](./audio_clip.py) | `audio_frame_app.lua` | Record a 5-second audio clip from the device microphone (RxAudio) and save it as a WAV file. |
| [`audio_duplex_sprites.py`](./audio_duplex_sprites.py) | `audio_duplex_sprites_frame_app.lua` | Halo-only: stream LC3 audio to the speaker and LC3 microphone audio back to the host while streaming 128x128 4bpp images (TxImageSpriteBlock), reporting whether each stream keeps up. |
| [`audio_stream.py`](./audio_stream.py) | `audio_frame_app.lua` | Stream microphone audio from the device (RxAudio in streaming mode) and play it live through the computer's speakers with pvspeaker. |
| [`audio_video_stream.py`](./audio_video_stream.py) | `audio_video_frame_app.lua` | Stream device microphone audio to the computer's speakers (RxAudio) while capturing and showing a photo (RxPhoto) every 5 seconds. |
| [`auto_exposure.py`](./auto_exposure.py) | `autoexp_frame_app.lua` | Frame-only: step the camera auto-exposure algorithm repeatedly (TxAutoExpSettings/RxAutoExpResult), printing each result and showing a photo taken at each step. |
| [`camera.py`](./camera.py) | `camera_frame_app.lua` | Take a photo with the device camera (TxCaptureSettings/RxPhoto) and open it in the system image viewer. |
| [`camera_extras.py`](./camera_extras.py) | `camera_extras_frame_app.lua` | Auto-capture a photo once the frameside app sees the IMU is stable, then receive it via RxPhoto (JPEG, or optionally QOI) and open it in the system viewer. |
| [`camera_sprite.py`](./camera_sprite.py) | `camera_image_sprite_block_frame_app.lua` | Take a photo with the device camera (RxPhoto) and show it back on the device display as a progressive TxImageSpriteBlock. |
| [`camera_sprite_loop.py`](./camera_sprite_loop.py) | `camera_image_sprite_block_frame_app.lua` | Continuously take photos (RxPhoto) and render each on the device display as a dithered 1-bit TxSprite sent as a TxImageSpriteBlock. |
| [`code_value.py`](./code_value.py) | `code_frame_app.lua` | Send a series of single-byte TxCode control messages to the device, where the frameside app prints each value as it arrives. |
| [`compress_decompress.py`](./compress_decompress.py) |  | Send lz4-compressed data to the device, which decompresses it on-device with frame.compression.decompress() and prints the original string back. |
| [`compressed_sprite_ind_png.py`](./compressed_sprite_ind_png.py) | `sprite_frame_app.lua`, `compressed_prog_sprite_frame_app.lua` | Display 1-, 2- and 4-bit indexed PNG images on the device display, sent as lz4-compressed TxSprite slices in a TxImageSpriteBlock. |
| [`imu.py`](./imu.py) | `imu_frame_app.lua` | Subscribe to IMU updates from the device (RxIMU) and print pitch, roll and raw compass values to the console. |
| [`imu_heading.py`](./imu_heading.py) |  | Live tilt-compensated heading using a saved MagCalibration. |
| [`layout.py`](./layout.py) | `layout/view.lua`, `layout/bg_view.lua`, `layout/header_view.lua`, `layout/body_view.lua`, `layout/footer_view.lua`, `layout/speech_wave.lua`, `layout/noa_layout.lua`, `layout/layout_frame_app.lua` | Halo-only: drive a simple Lua layout engine (header/body/footer/speech-wave views) with TxCode mode switches and TxTextSpriteBlock text. |
| [`live_camera_feed.py`](./live_camera_feed.py) | `camera_frame_app.lua` | Continuously capture photos from the device camera (TxCaptureSettings/RxPhoto) and display them live in an OpenCV window. |
| [`live_camera_feed_with_params.py`](./live_camera_feed_with_params.py) | `live_camera_frame_app.lua` | Frame-only: continuously capture photos (RxPhoto) and display them in an OpenCV window alongside live auto-exposure parameters (RxAutoExpResult). |
| [`manual_exposure.py`](./manual_exposure.py) | `manualexp_frame_app.lua` | Frame-only: set manual camera exposure settings (TxManualExpSettings), then take a photo (RxPhoto) and open it in the system viewer. |
| [`metering.py`](./metering.py) | `metering_frame_app.lua` | Frame-only: repeatedly query the camera's light metering data (RxMeteringData) and print the changing values to the console. |
| [`multi_tap.py`](./multi_tap.py) | `tap_frame_app.lua` | Subscribe to multi-tap events from the device (RxTap) and print the tap counts to the console. |
| [`openai_realtime.py`](./openai_realtime.py) | `openai_realtime_frame_app.lua` | Realtime voice conversation on Brilliant Halo via the OpenAI Realtime API. |
| [`plain_text.py`](./plain_text.py) | `plain_text_frame_app.lua` | Display a sequence of text strings on the device display using TxPlainText messages. |
| [`prog_sprite_jpg.py`](./prog_sprite_jpg.py) | `sprite_frame_app.lua`, `prog_sprite_frame_app.lua` | Display a JPEG image on the device display progressively, quantized to a 16-color TxSprite and sent slice-by-slice as a TxImageSpriteBlock to keep peak memory low. |
| [`sound_effects.py`](./sound_effects.py) | `sound_effects_frame_app.lua` | Halo-only: play the firmware's built-in sfxr sound effect presets through the speaker using the custom TxSoundEffect message. |
| [`speaker_lc3.py`](./speaker_lc3.py) | `speaker_frame_app.lua` | Halo-only: play an LC3 audio file through the device speaker by streaming LC3 frames with send_audio(), started and stopped via TxCode. |
| [`sprite_ind_png.py`](./sprite_ind_png.py) | `sprite_frame_app.lua` | Display 1-, 2- and 4-bit indexed PNG images on the device display using TxSprite messages. |
| [`sprite_jpg.py`](./sprite_jpg.py) | `sprite_frame_app.lua` | Display a JPEG image on the device display, quantized by TxSprite to 16 colors and resized to fit. |
| [`sprite_move.py`](./sprite_move.py) | `sprite_game_app.lua` | Send a 1-bit PNG sprite (TxSprite) to the device once, then move it around the display with TxSpriteCoords and TxCode draw messages. |
| [`text_sprite_block.py`](./text_sprite_block.py) | `text_sprite_block_frame_app.lua` | Display rasterized multilingual text (including right-to-left scripts) on the device display using TxTextSpriteBlock with user-specified fonts. |
| [`tx_sound_effect.py`](./tx_sound_effect.py) |  | Helper: custom TxSoundEffect message used by sound_effects.py (not a runnable example). |
| [`wake_on_audio.py`](./wake_on_audio.py) | `wake_on_audio_frame_app.lua` | Halo-only: let the device enter standby, then on wake (Audio Activity Detection, tap or Bluetooth) receive the streamed audio (RxAudio) and save it as a WAV file. |
